method: Truth = one checksum-valid code stated in structured data of the fetched page (independent scanner). ECDEV side = ecdev_core resolve() groups over page-subject records from the same bytes. Search snippets were never identity evidence.

independent_retailer_pairs.reason: Exact-identifier discovery found no independent-retailer page: retailer search surfaces had no static results (coolshop/hifi-regler 404, thomann no results, webhallen SPA); the book route (exlibris.ch, booktopia.com.au by ISBN URL) failed with proxy disconnects after 46 fetches, so INDEPENDENT_RETAILER and MANUFACTURER_VS_RETAILER stay UNKNOWN_RELATION, not assumed.
independent_retailer_pairs.next_action: Retry ISBN-URL fetches (exlibris, booktopia) on a network without proxy disconnects; the 13/13 Open Library catalogue-vs-ISBN pairs in identity-benchmark.json are CATALOGUE_DATABASE_VS_RETAILER-style evidence only.

gtin_misuse_in_the_wild: none observed in 200 pages (conflicting valid codes on one page: 0); absence recorded, not proof of absence
mpn_fallback: not measured: GTIN baseline already resolves all same-group positives; no defect shown, no heuristic added
seller_sku: The Elgiganten group shares SKUs across its own origins; SKU stays source-local and is never an identity key (unchanged).

defect_found_and_fixed.what: JSON-LD offers array carrying a public gross offer (599 DKK) and a business-only ex-VAT offer (479.2 DKK) was reported as price_status CONFLICT with a false 479.2-599 range, affecting every Elgiganten/Elkjop/Gigantti product and competition_evidence ranges.
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: Offers carry eligible_customer_type and audience (BUSINESS_ONLY or PUBLIC_OR_UNSTATED); headline price/range and competition price ranges exclude BUSINESS_ONLY offers, which stay visible as observed offers; two public offers that differ remain a CONFLICT.

competition_evidence.scope: OBSERVED_SAMPLE_ONLY, per-currency ranges, no FX conversion
competition_evidence.example: article 193793 DK/NO/FI resolves to one identity gtin:05722000134053 with 3 observations in 3 currencies (one page per currency).
competition_evidence.next_action: Observe an independent retailer by exact identifier; OFFICIAL_MARKETPLACE_VALIDATION_PENDING while SP-API credentials are absent.

bottleneck: Independent-retailer exact-identifier discovery (not identity resolution, which shows 0 false merges / 0 false splits on this sample).
